sanitization_rules: No transcript text from the private log in any committed fixture without review and sanitization.
No audio bytes in Git; WAV references are opaque IDs with hashes pointing at the private evidence root.
App names from analytics rows are private usage data; sanitized fixtures replace them with synthetic names.
Synthetic fixtures are labeled origin=synthetic and never counted as reviewed real evidence.
